=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py | Line or code reference: _push_targets lines 473-474; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py | same defect | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When _push_targets returns early for pure-deletion pushes (`delete and not uncertain → return []` at line 474, or `not refspecs → return []` when every refspec is a named branch deletion like `:branch`), the non-origin remote parsed earlier (e.g. `remote_value = "https://github.com/other/repo"`) is discarded. _evaluate_bash lines 1309-1313 receives an empty target list, loops zero times, and never reaches the remote-check at line 1319. Confirmation is silently skipped.
  WHY: `git push --repo=https://github.com/other/repo -d branch` or `git push https://github.com/other/repo :branch` deletes a branch on a non-origin repository without the confirmation the PR description mandates. The solo-`:` matching-refspec case (`git push https://github.com/other/repo :`) IS handled correctly because it sets `bulk = "pattern or matching refspec"` at line 490 and produces a target at line 512 that carries the remote. The gap is specific to named deletion refspecs and -d flag deletions.
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py | Line or code reference: Relay._reject, line 120 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `self.connection.settimeout(5)` in the finally block runs after the except OSError handler. If the socket was broken during the body-drain loop and the connection object is no longer valid, settimeout raises, and the exception propagates from _reject before send_error (line 121) or close_connection (line 122) execute.
  WHY: The client receives a connection reset instead of HTTP 400, and the connection may not be explicitly closed.

=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py | location: line 120 | PROBLEM: `self.connection.settimeout(5)` in the finally block of Relay._reject() could raise an unhandled OSError if the client socket was forcibly closed or reset during body draining before send_error executes. | suggested minimal fix: Wrap self.connection.settimeout(5) in a try/except OSError: pass block so that unexpected socket state does not prevent send_error from completing.

=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py | Line or code reference: lines 119-120 (Relay._reject, inside the `drain_body` try/except's `finally` block) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `self.connection.settimeout(5)` runs in a `finally` block with no exception guard. If `self.connection` is `None` (e.g., the client closed the connection between `setup()` and the drain), or if the underlying socket is already closed/reset, `settimeout()` raises `OSError` or `AttributeError` and propagates out of `_reject` before `send_error(status, "Request rejected")` (line 121) and `self.close_connection = True` (line 122) execute.
  WHY: A peer that disconnects during a large-body rejection is the exact case the drain logic was added to handle. A `settimeout(5)` that itself raises defeats the purpose by masking the rejection with a connection error.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py | Line or code reference: _push_targets, lines 473-474 (`if delete and not uncertain: return []  # Deletes do not strand new commits on a branch.`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The early return at lines 473-474 discards the computed `remote_value` when every refspec is a branch deletion (e.g., `git push https://github.com/other/repo :branch1`). The last run added `remote=remote_value` to the bulk target at line 512, which fixes the matching-refspec / pattern case the new test `test_matching_refspec_on_unverified_remote_does_not_check_origin` covers, but the branch-deletion-only path still returns `[]` before the remote can be recorded.
  WHY: A push like `git push https://other-repo :feature` to a non-origin remote silently passes with no confirmation.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py | Line or code reference: lines 40 and 90 (the `allowed()` allowlist and `enumerate_workspace()` walk) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `.claude/commands/` is excluded from the review autofix editor's allowed paths and workspace enumeration, so the unattended editor cannot snapshot or transfer edits to `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md`.
  WHY: The PR's own review pipeline repeatedly notes this blocker; the last run does not widen the allowlist, so the next review pass will hit the same wall.
- Requirement: The CI failure in `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` is caused by `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` diverging from `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` (the canonical template). The CI log shows the test expects the canonical wording "Claude-engine orchestrator hand-off" / "default-engine orchestrator hand-off" at lines 103 and 126, and "an in-flight legacy `/implement-plan-claude` project" at line 127, but the root file still has "in-session" / "AI orchestrator" / the missing "legacy" prefix. The PR description (proactive fixes included) claims the audit-plans parity is being addressed; the diff does not include the fix.
  Expected change site: `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` lines 103, 126, 127 — and (already done in the template) `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` is the reference, not the divergence.
  Evidence of absence: The file `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` is unchanged in both the LAST RUN DIFF and the full PR DIFF. Lines 103, 126, 127 still read "implement-plan-claude (in-session) or /implement-plan-ai (AI orchestrator) as the follow-up" / "Claude implements it in-session" / "hand it to the AI orchestrator" / "the plan of an in-flight `/implement-plan-claude` project never moves either". The template at `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md:103,126,127` already has the corrected wording. `tests/test_audit_plans_command.py` asserts byte-for-byte equality between the two — the CI failure log tail in the PR check-runs context confirms `1 failed, 8 passed in 0.12s` for the parity test, and the aggregate `lint` job fails because `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator: failure`.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: The LAST RUN DIFF added `remote=remote_value` to the bulk target in `_push_targets` (line 512 of `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` and its template twin). This is the fix for the matching-refspec / pattern case the new test `test_matching_refspec_on_unverified_remote_does_not_check_origin` covers. The PR description lists it as a completed fix. The fix is correct and present.
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py line 512 and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py line 512 (already done in the last run).
  Evidence of absence: Not a gap — included for completeness. The fix is in both copies and matches the test's expectation that `git push https://github.com/other/repo :` pro
